counterfactual_missing_items: a right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
decisive_items: a right breast mass noted for more than 1 year
response.rationale: R5 integrates the long-standing mass, ulceration, and imaging findings (BI-RADS V, CT malignancy), whereas R3 omits the ulceration and duration. R1 and R2 rely solely on ulceration without imaging, and R6 misinterprets normal tumor markers as diagnostic.

rejected.why: Paget's disease of the breast is not supported by the mass location (not nipple) and lacks imaging evidence.
Inflammatory breast cancer is not a standard diagnosis and the ulceration alone is insufficient without imaging.
Normal serum tumor markers do not indicate triple-negative subtype; this is a non-diagnostic observation.
